async def k01(items, rows, read):
    # CASE unrelated_tuple expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        other, tail = rows[item]
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        use(saved, other, tail)


async def k02(items, rows, out, read):
    # CASE tuple_index_uses_lazy expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        out[saved], count = rows[item]


async def k03(items, rows, read):
    # CASE tuple_attr_of_lazy expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        saved.value, count = rows[item]


async def k04(items, rows, out, read):
    # CASE subscript_assign_uses_lazy expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        out[saved] = rows[item]


async def k05(items, read):
    # CASE augmented_other expect=pass
    saved = None
    count = 0
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        count += 1


async def k06(items, read):
    # CASE plain_lazy expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        use(saved, item)


async def k07(items, read):
    # CASE closure_assign expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)

        def later():
            saved = None
            return saved

        use(later, item)


async def k08(items, read):
    # CASE comprehension_names expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        pairs = [(saved, x) for x in item.children]
        use(pairs)


async def k09(items, rows, read):
    # CASE tuple_rhs_has_lazy expect=pass
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        left, right = saved, rows[item]
        use(left, right)


async def k10(items, read):
    # CASE swap_unrelated expect=pass
    saved = None
    a, b = 1, 2
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read(item)
        a, b = b, a
